scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run build:wellness && vite build && node scripts/assert-physical-acceptance-labels.mjs
scripts.build:engineering: tsc -b && npm run build:wellness && vite build --mode engineering && node scripts/assert-physical-acceptance-labels.mjs --engineering
scripts.sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:android:engineering: npm run build:engineering && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:connection-diagnostic: tsc -b && npm run build:wellness && vite build --mode connection-diagnostic && node scripts/assert-physical-acceptance-labels.mjs --connection-diagnostic
scripts.build:activity-v2-verification: tsc -b && npm run build:wellness && vite build --mode activity-v2-verification && node scripts/assert-physical-acceptance-labels.mjs --activity-v2-verification
scripts.sync:android:connection-diagnostic: npm run build:connection-diagnostic && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:android:activity-v2-verification: npm run build:activity-v2-verification && npx cap sync android
scripts.test:wellness: npm run build:wellness && vitest run src/wellness --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1
